infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Used only while you're recording a note, so you can capture a task by speaking instead of typing.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Used to turn the note you just spoke into a task. Nothing is recorded in the background.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Used when you choose a photo of a business card to read, or a picture for a person or for yourself. The One Thing never reads your other photos.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Used when you take a photo of a business card to read, or a picture for a person or for yourself. The camera is never used in the background.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Used to show your phone’s contacts so you can pick who to add to People. Only the people you pick are saved, and your contacts are never uploaded.
